verdict.rationale: Belvo documents a 'get started in 10 minutes' quickstart that sets developers up with API keys, a forkable Postman collection and a simple API flow, plus a sandbox for testing the full API. A hands-on sign-up report showed a confusing 'retry later' error even though the account was created, and nothing in the evidence shows client libraries. Missing for 10: any evidence of client libraries/SDKs in specific languages, explicit documentation of self-serve key issuance and of creating a first sandbox link, and a smooth corroborated signup experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can go from signup to my first linked sandbox account fast — self-serve API keys, a runnable quickstart, and client libraries in my language
